🔊 Sound & Feedback
Rest countdown & completion sounds
Audio cues for "3, 2, 1, Go" + ding when timer ends
Countdown style
Both keep Spotify / Apple Music playing. Voice speaks "3, 2, 1, Go"; Beeps plays synth tones.
Record bundled countdown voice OWNER
Tap Record then say each word clearly. ~1.4s per clip. When done, tap 📋 Copy JS snippet and paste the result into BUNDLED_VOICE_CLIPS in index.html. Commit + deploy and every user hears your voice.
🏃 Garry's Workout Settings
Runner Level
Pick the level that best matches your current running fitness. Treadmill speed ranges in Garry's workouts adjust to suit.
🌱 Beginner
  • New to running or returning after a long break
  • Comfortable walking but building running fitness
  • Can jog for short bursts (1–2 minutes)
🏃 Intermediate
  • Run regularly (3–6 months experience)
  • Can sustain a jog for 10–20 minutes
  • Building stamina and speed confidence
⚡ Advanced
  • Experienced runner (6+ months consistent training)
  • Comfortable running at pace for 30+ minutes
  • Uses intervals and speed work regularly
🔥 Elite
  • Competitive or highly trained runner
  • High sustained speeds feel comfortable
  • Pushes maximum effort during sprints
ℹ️ How we use this info
• Your weight is used to calculate bodyweight exercise volume in Muscle Balance
• Height helps track body composition over time
• All data is saved locally on your device

☁️ Syncing…
Nudges you when a muscle group is overdue — shown when you next open the app (background push coming later).
Adds an optional effort chip when logging a set — the coach uses it to fine-tune weight suggestions.
A rolling 4-week rhythm (build → push → recover) that eases off borderline jumps on recovery weeks.
Accessory exercises rotate through fresh variations each time you repeat a workout day. Main lifts never change.
DATA BACKUP
Export everything (sessions, custom programmes, body weight, prefs) as a JSON file. Import to restore on a new device or roll back.
